review_candidates.description: Backed by NASA, DARPA, and Space Force, we are a venture backed, rapidly growing startup with the ultimate goal of asteroid mining through our space platforms. The role will lead configuration design, interface definition, mass and balance control, and integration planning while coordinating structural, thermal, electrical and RF disciplines. The engineer will own configuration baselines, support AIT and environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, shock), and ensure successful launch vehicle integration and mission support. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain spacecraft and satellite configuration baselines and change control processes throughout formulation, design, AIT and operations phases. Perform or coordinate mass properties, center-of-gravity and balance analyses and maintain mass budgets and margin reports. Coordinate structural and thermal analyses (NASTRAN, ANSYS), tolerance and view-factor analyses, and interpret results to drive design changes with engineering teams. Plan, write and execute environmental test plans and procedures including thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock and EMI/EMC/ESD testing; support test campaigns and hardware qualification. Integrate RF/communications subsystems and antennas into the spacecraft configuration; support RF performance verification and antenna deployment validation. Design, review and verify deployable mechanisms, separation systems and associated verification testing and acceptance criteria. Own AIT/Assembly integration sequencing, GSE requirements and launch vehicle integration activities; provide technical direction to AIT teams and suppliers. Manage requirements and traceability using tools such as DOORS and Jama; author and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) and configuration documentation. Experience with deployable systems, mechanisms, robotics, capture systems, or other moving aerospace hardware. Knowledge of launch vehicle integration constraints, payload accommodations, and mission interface requirements. Experience with mass properties tracking, configuration management, and engineering data control processes.
